A cinematic Disney-Pixar style 3D animated short scene in a sun-dappled 
autumn park during warm golden hour. The setting features an old weathered 
dark wooden park bench with peeling paint beneath a massive maple tree 
blazing with vibrant orange, amber and yellow leaves, a soft bokeh 
background of more autumn foliage with a distant glowing vintage lamppost 
on the right. Fallen maple leaves are scattered across the bench and the 
ground. Two children are the focus: on the left, a young girl named Lily 
with voluminous fiery red-orange curly hair, big bright emerald green eyes, 
soft freckles across her nose and cheeks, fair skin with rosy cheeks, 
wearing a buttercup-yellow floral-patterned sundress with a crisp white 
peter-pan collar and two small white buttons, white canvas sneakers. On 
the right, a young boy named Max with messy fluffy chestnut-brown hair, 
bright sky-blue eyes, light warm skin with rosy cheeks, wearing blue denim 
overalls with brass buttons and cuffed legs over a red-and-white horizontal 
striped t-shirt, brown leather sneakers. Painterly textures, rich warm 
color palette, expressive cartoon faces with subsurface scattering, soft 
golden rim light, cinematic shallow depth of field, gentle floating dust 
particles in the sunbeams.

Wide two-shot of both children sitting on the weathered wooden bench. 
Lily on the left holds up a small folded piece of old tan paper in her 
right hand at shoulder height, leaning slightly toward Max with a wide 
joyful open smile, her bright green eyes sparkling with barely-contained 
excitement. Her mouth moves naturally and expressively as she speaks 
with breathless wonder. Her fiery red curls bounce gently as she 
gestures. Max on the right sits calmly with his hands resting on his 
lap, slowly turning his head a little more toward Lily, his blue eyes 
softening with growing curiosity, a small interested smile forming at 
the corner of his mouth. By the end of this segment, Lily's hands begin 
to lower the paper toward her lap as if about to unfold it. Subtle 
ambient motion in the background: a few autumn leaves drift slowly down 
through the warm golden light, dappled sunlight flickers softly on the 
characters. Static camera, no zoom, intimate medium-wide framing. | The camera focus naturally tightens to a medium close-up. Lily has now 
unfolded the old tan paper into a full hand-drawn treasure map showing 
a bold red X mark, dotted trails, tiny mountains, trees, and a small 
pirate ship illustration. She holds the map open with both hands between 
them, smiling proudly and watching Max's reaction with delighted 
anticipation, her green eyes glowing. Max on the right reacts with 
explosive amazement: his blue eyes go enormously wide in stunned 
disbelief, mouth dropping open into a slow awed "whoa" expression, 
both of his hands rising up dramatically beside his face in a shocked 
gesture, fingers spread. His mouth then moves naturally as he speaks 
with mounting excitement and growing wonder, hands gesturing 
expressively. His messy brown hair shifts and bounces with the sudden 
animated movement. Warm sunlight flickers across his astonished face 
through the swaying maple leaves above. Static camera, no zoom, focused 
emotional close-up, only character animation drives the energy. | The energy bursts forward into joyful motion. Lily springs up from the 
bench first with overflowing excitement, the folded treasure map now 
clutched in her right hand raised triumphantly, her left hand reaching 
out to grab Max's right hand. Max immediately rises with a bright 
excited grin, being pulled forward, his free right arm flying up into 
the air in pure exhilaration. The two children together rush forward 
toward the camera, running side by side past the wooden bench which 
recedes behind them, both laughing with wide open joyful smiles. Lily's 
mouth moves naturally as she speaks with urgent breathless enthusiasm, 
her words tumbling out with the running motion. Her fiery red curls 
bounce and fly with the momentum, her yellow dress flutters around her 
knees. Max's messy hair flies back from the running motion. Autumn 
leaves explode upward and swirl around their feet as they run, dancing 
in the warm golden light. The weathered bench and glowing maple tree 
remain visible behind them in soft focus. Subtle natural camera follow 
backward as they approach, dynamic but graceful childlike running 
motion, warm cinematic golden hour rim light.
